text: Drinking highly alkaline water cures type 1 diabetes within thirty days without medical insulin.
justification: Evidence 2 indicates alkaline water may improve insulin sensitivity in type 1 diabetes but the patient still had elevated HbA1c (7.7%) months later and required ongoing management, showing no cure within 30 days without insulin.

text: NASA staged and faked all six Apollo moon landings on an underground movie soundstage in Nevada.

text: Eating carrots gives humans superhuman night vision capabilities due to military radar technology.
justification: Evidence shows the carrot night‑vision claim was WWII propaganda to hide radar use and that carrots do not grant superhuman vision, only normal health benefits.
